thread:
alex: Heads-up — seeing intermittent tail-latency spikes on multivariant routing in pool-A. Appears when requests fallback from fp16 -> 8-bit quantized variant. Batch formation waits shoot up (~50-120ms).

maria: Is this the same regression we saw last week or a new pattern? Any KV cache misses correlated?

alex: New pattern. KV miss rate jumps during the fallback windows. Also kernel selection seems to oscillate between matmul_fast_8bit and matmul_generic for the same model shard.

jon: Could be kernel heuristics using stale perf profiles after compatset expansion. When we route to the quantized variant, its profile says lower throughput so the batcher fragments.

sophia: Pasted a small log excerpt from the canary:
```
[2026-03-17T09:12:33Z] model=rwkv-q8 variant=q8 kernel=matmul_generic latency=21ms
[2026-03-17T09:12:33Z] model=rwkv-q8 variant=q8 kernel=matmul_fast_8bit latency=8ms
[2026-03-17T09:12:33Z] compatset=multi-variant fallback=triggered token_budget=64
[2026-03-17T09:12:33Z] queue_wait=62ms batch_size=3 kv_cache.misses=2
```

yang: That kernel flip looks like jitter from the kernel selector probing microbenchmarks at runtime. If the selector samples on warmup and then re-evaluates after KV warmup, it can flip and change batching characteristics.

maria: Also note token_budget is low (64) for that route. Batcher may be holding off forming larger batches when variant compatibility is low.

alex: I think two things are colliding: (1) routing -> fallback causes sudden change in model footprint (KV cache pressure), (2) kernel selection oscillation changes per-token throughput causing the continuous batcher to time out. Result = queue smear and tail increases.

jon: Quick test idea: increase token_budget target for that route to 128 and bump prefetch_kv=true for the quantized variant. See if the batcher coalesces instead of stalling.

sophia: I'll try a canary with token_budget=128 + prefetch_kv enabled and add a pinned kernel hint to prefer matmul_fast_8bit for the q8 variant (to avoid selector churn).

perf-bot: Perf alert -> route /generate (pool-A) p95 latency jumped 40% in the last 30m. Linked metrics: batch_formation_ms, kv_miss_rate, kernel_switch_rate.

alex: Thanks perf-bot. If prefetch reduces KV misses we should see both kv_miss_rate and batch_formation_ms drop.

maria: If pinned kernels fix it, we still need a long-term fix: selector shouldn't flip-flop on live traffic when compatset membership is transient. Maybe add hysteresis on kernel re-eval and factor in recent kv_miss_rate.

yang: Agreed. Also consider adjusting queue policy: allow permissive merge for small batches when compatset heterogeneity is detected. That reduces fragmentation when fallback is frequent.

sophia: Canary deployed with token_budget=128, prefetch_kv=true, kernel_hint=matmul_fast_8bit. Will monitor for 10m.

ops-bot: Canary rollout: 10% -> 30% in pool-A. Auto-rollback window 5m.

jon: If this stabilizes, let's create a follow-up issue: 1) add selector hysteresis + kv-aware scoring, 2) expose token_budget recommendations per route in console, 3) add a heuristic to pre-warm KV when fallback recognized.

alex: Agreed. Action owners: sophia -> canary + logs, yang -> proposal for selector hysteresis, maria -> queue policy experiment and monitoring dashboard. I'll collect traces for next sync.

sophia: Update after 6min: batch_formation_ms down ~28%, kv_miss_rate down 40%, p95 still slightly above baseline but trending down.

alex: Nice. Keep it running for 30m and then we can roll forward. Thanks all :thumbsup:
